column1: # Network PCI IDs the hardware setup recognises: id, the driver of our kernel that claims it,
# the firmware package it needs ("-" none, BROADCOM-WL = the closed wl driver case), a note.
#  - MediaTek and Realtek rows: the ID tables and modules.alias of our own kernel
#    the linux tree), as listed in sparky-os/notes/gaming-rig-map-and-plan.md section 4b.3.
#    rtw89_8922de is enabled by kernel/configure.sh (it was off in Debian's configuration).
#  - Broadcom rows: Debian's broadcom-sta-dkms README (6.30.223.271-32) list of supported IDs, joined
#    with the device list of CachyOS's chwd profile broadcom-wl
#    matches vendor 14a4, which is not carried here. The licence of wl is Broadcom's (Debian's
#    copyright file of broadcom-sta-source): distribution "complete, unmodified and only for use with a
#    Broadcom Product", with an indemnity clause; Debian ships it in non-free.
#  - Intel and Qualcomm Atheros Wi-Fi are matched by vendor in detect.py, not listed here.
